app.name: GramDisha AI
app.tagline: Your village. Your business. Your smartest financial plan.

landing.hero_title: Turn Your Business Idea Into a Data-Backed Plan
landing.hero_subtitle: AI-powered business advisory for rural entrepreneurs. Get market intelligence, financial structuring, and viability analysis — all in one place.
landing.layer1_desc: Understand your local market — demand, competition, customer segments, and opportunities in your area.
landing.layer2_desc: Know exactly how much you can borrow, your EMI, and whether your business can sustain the loan.
landing.layer3_desc: Get a clear viability score, risk analysis, and actionable recommendation — should you start this business?

assessment.title: Business Assessment
assessment.subtitle: Tell us about your business plan and we'll analyze its viability.
assessment.capital_help: This is the money you have available to invest in your business (also called margin money or own contribution).

validation.capital_positive: Capital must be greater than zero.

market.title: Market Analysis
market.subtitle: Local market intelligence based on available indicators.

financial.title: Financial Structure
financial.subtitle: Detailed financial analysis of your business plan.
financial.emi_note: Estimated EMI — illustrative calculation. Final repayment schedule depends on lending-agency terms.
financial.moratorium_note: During the moratorium period, EMI payments are typically deferred. Actual terms depend on the lending agency.
financial.repayment_disclaimer: Illustrative repayment projection based on standard EMI assumptions. Final repayment schedule is subject to the lending agency's terms.
financial.loan_clamped: Loan amount has been capped to the scheme's maximum limit.
financial.health_comfortable_desc: Your business is projected to comfortably service the loan with a healthy surplus.
financial.health_tight_desc: Your business can service the loan but with a limited surplus. Maintain strict cost control.
financial.health_risky_desc: Business may struggle to service the proposed loan under current assumptions.
